Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Previously, Marthe Dizier couldn't retrieve a Psyche! because Psyche! was played outside a combat.
Now that Psyche! is played during combat, can she retrieve and play the same Psyche! as long as she has blood to do it?

Name: Psyche!
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Celerity
[cel] Press.
[CEL] Only usable at the end of a round when both combatants are still ready and combat is about to end. After this round, begin another combat with the opposing minion.

Name: Marthe Dizier
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Toreador antitribu
Group: 3
Capacity: 10
Discipline: pro AUS CEL OBF PRE
Sabbat. Black Hand: When a combat involving Marthe ends, she can burn a blood to move a card she played during that combat from your ash heap to your hand. +1 bleed.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
